input: Pressure wash the back patio before summer

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The patio may include just the main slab, or also furniture, walls, fences, or drainage areas — this changes how long the job takes and what equipment is needed.
A specific deadline (e.g. a date or event) determines urgency and how soon prep steps must begin.
Whether the user owns a pressure washer, needs to rent one, or plans to hire someone out entirely changes the first action completely.
Heavy moss, oil stains, or mildew may require pre-treatment with detergents before pressure washing, adding steps to the plan.
If the user is doing it solo vs. with help vs. hiring a professional, the plan and cost implications differ significantly.
A budget cap affects whether renting equipment, buying supplies, or hiring out is viable.
Knowing the end goal — e.g. purely functional clean, or guest-ready, photo-worthy appearance — sets the quality bar and whether sealing or touch-ups are part of done.
